caption: The video captures a daytime sky dominated by a flat layer of grey-blue cloud, with the sun concealed just behind a cloud edge at right-of-center. This hidden source produces a bright glowing patch and a broad fan of crepuscular rays that stream downward and to the right, while fainter rays spill toward the left. A horizontal band of cloud with brightly backlit, silver-lined edges crosses the middle, and a smaller lit cloud patch sits at the lower left beneath a smooth, featureless blue-grey upper sky. The overall composition stays broadly fixed: the glowing sun-edge, the lit cloud band, the lower-left patch, and the fan of rays persist, showing no large cloud translation or obvious camera pan or zoom. Only very subtle, low-amplitude shimmering and slight changes in the brightness and crispness of the rays and cloud-edge highlights occur over time. No ray clearly grows, moves, or disappears as a discrete event, and no obvious object enters or exits.
